about_the_game:
"Legends tell of a die named Snogbert...

Does he have infinite sides, or only one?"

About the Game

Snogbert is a one-room 2D platformer that combines arcade run-and-jump gameplay with roguelike progression. 

But in Snogbert, it's not just the levels that are random...it's the missions that happen in them! With just a roll of the dice, our hero could need to do anything from smelling flowers to outrunning shadow copies of himself! These 10+ unique missions change the way you'll explore each level. Feeling lucky?

Story

The legendary infinite-sided (or one-sided?) die has fallen through layers of cave into the Brick Bunker at its bottom, and pieces of him chipped off on the way down! To get Snogbert home, you'll have to help him through 5 distinct worlds and collect his missing shards along the way. Each world is painted in its own color palette and adds new enemies, items, and missions to the fray! 

These challenges lurk around every corner, and the biggest obstacle of all is the elusive and mysterious Shadowmaster...

But with your help, there's nothing Snogbert can't do! Make use of our hero's unique momentum-based wall-jump to soar to new heights. Master his movement to roll through every platforming challenge. Overcome the random missions and escape from the caves! Ready to roll?
